<script>
(() => {
  const scene = document.querySelector('.mountain-hero');
  if (!scene || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  const birds = [...scene.querySelectorAll('.sky-bird')];
  const resetFlock = () => birds.forEach((bird) => {
    bird.style.setProperty('--fly-x', '0px');
    bird.style.setProperty('--fly-y', '0px');
    bird.classList.remove('is-startled');
  });

  scene.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    const bounds = scene.getBoundingClientRect();
    birds.forEach((bird) => {
      const birdX = bounds.left + bounds.width * Number(bird.dataset.x) / 100;
      const birdY = bounds.top + bounds.height * Number(bird.dataset.y) / 100;
      const deltaX = birdX - event.clientX;
      const deltaY = birdY - event.clientY;
      const distance = Math.hypot(deltaX, deltaY);
      const startle = Math.max(0, 1 - distance / 190);
      bird.style.setProperty('--fly-x', `${deltaX / (distance || 1) * startle * 52}px`);
      bird.style.setProperty('--fly-y', `${deltaY / (distance || 1) * startle * 38 - startle * 16}px`);
      bird.classList.toggle('is-startled', startle > 0);
    });
  });
  scene.addEventListener('pointerleave', resetFlock);
})();
</script>

<section class="portfolio-section" id="projects">
<p class="eyebrow">03 · Career highlights · Telstra</p>
<h2>Reliable systems, from ingestion to operations.</h2>
<p class="section-intro">A few examples of the data and ML platforms I built and operated across my Telstra career.</p>

<div class="project-grid">
<article class="project-card">
<p class="project-label">Data platform · Azure</p>
<h3>Datacore (DNA)</h3>
<p>Built and maintained Azure Data Factory pipelines for data ingestion and transformation, landing Parquet data in ADLS and replicating it to PostgreSQL for downstream access. Used Databricks and Control-M to run and monitor analytics workflows, with modular pipelines designed for new sources and requirements.</p>
<p class="project-stack">Azure Data Factory · ADLS · Databricks · PostgreSQL · Control-M</p>
</article>
<article class="project-card">
<p class="project-label">ML operations · AWS</p>
<h3>Fraud and account-takeover prevention</h3>
<p>Designed AWS data pipelines for ML model onboarding, defined onboarding rules and model performance metrics, and built QuickSight dashboards to monitor training data and model output.</p>
<p class="project-stack">AWS · ML onboarding · Amazon QuickSight</p>
</article>
<article class="project-card">
<p class="project-label">Data &amp; ML platform · Streaming</p>
<h3>ONE Analytics</h3>
<p>Developed large-scale Scala and Spark ingestion pipelines connecting Salesforce, SFTP, and Kafka sources to Hive and PostgreSQL. Added a centralized pipeline-monitoring framework and connected PagerDuty and Grafana for alerting and job tracking.</p>
<p class="project-stack">Scala · Spark · Kafka · Hive · PostgreSQL · Grafana</p>
</article>
<article class="project-card project-card-highlight">
<p class="project-label">Platform migration · Azure</p>
<h3>Modernizing data flows</h3>
<p>Partnered with product managers to redesign pipelines and move data flows from Informatica to Azure. The migration achieved <strong>$1M in operational cost savings</strong>; supporting work included CI/CD, data-quality controls, and automated warehouse and quality-monitoring workflows.</p>
<p class="project-stack">Azure Data Factory · SQL Server · ADLS · Docker · Jenkins</p>
</article>
</div>
